\item \textit{Note:} Covered gives the count and percentage of observations within the closed 2.5th--97.5th percentile interval. For interval score, bold marks the minimum within each horizon. Width is reported as a sharpness summary and is not optimized separately. Persistence has zero width. Numerical quantile conventions are specified in Appendix~\ref{app:numericalprediction}. The monotone inverse transformation preserves coverage. N, AL and exAL denote normal, asymmetric Laplace and extended asymmetric Laplace likelihoods; U and M denote one and multiple observation sources. T1 retains the transfer contribution at forecast leads and T0 omits it.
